test.create_query: CREATE TABLE window_functions_qualify_v2 (k UInt64, g UInt32, v UInt32, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO window_functions_qualify_v2 SELECT sipHash64(number) % 9600000, number % 160000, (number * 7919) % 1000003, toString(number) FROM numbers_mt(16000000)
test.query: SELECT k, v FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY count() OVER (PARTITION BY k) = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT k, v FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY count() OVER (PARTITION BY k) > 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT g, v, s FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY v DESC) <= 3 FORMAT Null
SELECT g, v FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY rank() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY v DESC) <= 3 FORMAT Null
SELECT g, v FROM (SELECT g, v FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC) = 1) QUALIFY v > avg(v) OVER (PARTITION BY g % 1000) FORMAT Null
